notes.title: Some News
notes.content:
Hello! It's been a while since the last post. This is mostly a part time thing but... even though things move very slow, they have been moving.

Cool new, totally nothing of interest banner:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458163/9b5fea8af373f7f7c0a7f60a47345e9cb14b70ff.png[/img]

[i]Insert cool transition [/i]

Progress on Dark Space, has [u]unfortunately been very slow[/u]. Although it's because of two things:
1. Slow work on project
2. Something new...

I won't give too much away but here's this:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458163/2583489547d4e930a69c945113957de2444abc6c.png[/img]

This "thing" I'm currently working on is something that, I hope, will be very cool and will have plenty of playability. Here is one more small hint.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458163/fa29a35fdd0a8db4e054d5b6e6874cf316ebf77d.png[/img]

Also.... The release for this game is still TBD, and as of now, this game with be 100% free on release.
Even with the date being TBD, it will Definitely not be ANY time soon because its mostly unfinished.  

Anyway, hopefully there will be more information soon and always some very silly dumb games.
ːsteamhappyː

if the images don't work, they will be fixed later.
